immutable_c1_artifacts.rule: 下游资格、画像和设计仅可通过 canonical_annotation_id sidecar join；不得回写这些工件。

gates.C1_CANONICAL_CLOSED: identity, assignment/version/duplicate disposition and raw snapshot binding are complete; it does not assert measurement support.
gates.C1_MEASUREMENT_FROZEN: collection closure plus canonical closure and separately evaluable Q_GT, held-out LOO and structural axes; no axis may substitute another.
gates.C2B_DESIGN_READY: C1 measurement freeze plus complete SHA-bound pre-annotation C1 model/layout features; it does not freeze risk, design, assignment or routing.

risk_channels.risk_design_vector_A: the sole ordered four-channel C2-B exposure from frozen pre-annotation model/layout evidence and C1 support distance.
risk_channels.risk_design_score_A: the sole continuous scalar derived from risk_design_vector_A; it owns stratum, worker slope, bridge maximin and simulation exposure.
risk_channels.risk_route: V1 routing only after C2-B confirmation; never a C2-B assignment prerequisite.

disposition_requirements.failure_mode: missing, stale, conflicting or unmatched disposition is not_evaluable and blocks the affected formal estimand.

forbidden_feedback: T1/V1 outcomes cannot alter C1 eligibility, C2-B risk, thresholds, worker profiles or assignment selection.
crowd canonical geometry cannot supply C1 pre-annotation risk features.
rehearsal artifacts, worktree patches and candidate assignments cannot be finalized or imported as formal assignments.
legacy_diagnostic_only: r_u and legacy profile freeze artifacts
